race.comment: TAVIJEWEL (2) sets the standard off a BM66 placing at Dubbo, where he was near the top of betting and held third behind Godwits. He is proven at this track and distance, gets a 2kg claim and can give this a shake. BOLD TYRANT (8) is the main danger if judged on his Mudgee second two starts back, beaten just under a length in BM50 grade, with Ken Dunbar back aboard and a softer assignment he is a major player. LADY TINO (1) also comes through that Dubbo BM66, finishing fourth behind Godwits after looking a chance on the turn, and her record around 2100m gives her solid each-way  hopes. DUNEDIN (3) has not shown a great deal in two runs at 1600m, but he drops out of an Open at Dubbo, has won at around 2100m and can improve enough to chase a placing.
